evals_reused_note: Origin ships no evals/ directory. Authored fresh from the origin SKILL.md's workflow: gather reference images + project idea, extract a design system from images via subagent, generate an MVP PRD if absent, then produce implementation-ready UI prompts.
live_dependency_note: Reference images are provided as local fixtures (attached to the request) rather than fetched from a live service; output is a design-system document/PRD, which is fully local and text/markdown-gradeable.
